zoomText:
Zoom meetings

Zoom runs the meeting. Orbit keeps its reviewed deal activity, preparation and follow-up.

Unresolved setup. Connect the owner’s Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth app.

Connect Zoom

Use your Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth app. Orbit checks it with Zoom before saving credentials in this installation’s sealed storage. They are never shown again or exported. After a restore, connect again.

Zoom account ID
Zoom client ID
Zoom client secret
Zoom webhook secret token
Check and connect Zoom

Subscribe the Zoom app to meeting.ended and meeting.deleted. Set its Event notification endpoint URL to http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/v1/signals/zoom. Grant read access to scheduled meetings and past meeting participants. Zoom validates the endpoint using your secret token.

Recording and transcript content is never fetched. A missing transcript or ungranted recording permission stays visible on the meeting plan.
